about_description: The Digital Commerce Integration is an integrated platform that brings merchants, suppliers and delivery teams together in one place, organising the full cycle from the moment an order is created until it reaches the customer. The drivers app is part of that platform, giving each driver everything the working day needs: receiving the route assigned by the supervisor, following delivery and pickup points in order on the map, updating the status of every order as it happens, and reporting any problem on the road right away. All of it through a simple Arabic and English interface that cuts down manual follow ups and keeps operations running clearly and in order.
